shortDescription: AkzoNobel EURONEXT:AKZA is nearing a deal to sell its south-east Asian decorative paints business to Nippon Paint TSE:4612 for well over $1 billion, the Financial Times reported on Sunday citing people familiar with the matter.Reuters could not immediately verify the FT report.
